test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Ustad Bundu Khan and Santosh Mishra are the famous players of which musical instrument:
solution:
The correct answer is __**sarangi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Bundu Khan (1880 – 1955)**:​

 
 
• He was a **sarangi playe**r from India.
 
• Bundu Khan was also a** musicologist or musical theorist**.
 
• In** June 1934**, his music book **Jauhar-i-Mausiqi in Urdu** was concurrently released in **Hindi and Urdu.**
 
• In **1985**, the President of Pakistan presented him with the** Pride of Performance Award.**
 
 
 
• **Santosh Mishra**:
 
 
• He was one of Varanasi's most successful sarangi players.
 
• He is the **eldest son of Pandit Bhagwan Das Mishra** who was a veteran of the **Banaras Gharana.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sitar:**

 
 
• A **plucked stringed instrument** with** moveable frets **and a **gourd resonator** is known as a sitar.
 
 
 
• **shehnai:**
 
 
• It is composed of wood, with a **double reed** on one end, and a** flared bell **made of **wood or metal **on the other.
 
 
 
• **sarangi:**
 
 
• A short-necked **bowed string instrument** is the sarangi.
 
 
 
• **sarod:**
 
 
• A** stringed instrument** known as the sarod is utilized in** Hindustani music** on the Indian subcontinent.
